manipulation_or_design: Hypnotic suggestion for more vs less unpleasantness of constant hot water
direction_note: Unpleasantness 81 vs 45; ACC activity moved, S1 did not
caveats: Selected for the effect; intensity 78 vs 71 n.s., not equivalence; fixed state order

manipulation_or_design: Hypnotic suggestion for stronger vs weaker pain
direction_note: Both ratings moved (r=0.81); S1 moved with suggestion, ACC did not
caveats: Double dissociation only across two samples; selected sample; fixed state order

manipulation_or_design: Sustained jaw pain vs placebo; opioid release correlated with scores across people
direction_note: Different but overlapping regions correlated with sensory vs affective questionnaire scores
caveats: Intensity held at 40-60 VAS; 'affect' is MPQ subscale, not unpleasantness rating

manipulation_or_design: Attend to location vs unpleasantness of identical laser pulses
direction_note: Location: S1 and parietal; unpleasantness: pACC, OFC, amygdala, hypothalamus, M1
caveats: Attention not percept manipulated; S1 effect P=0.05 corrected; men only

manipulation_or_design: Dopamine-precursor depletion vs balanced amino-acid drink
direction_note: Unpleasantness 5.6 vs 4.7 (p=.048), scaling with tyrosine depletion; EEG unchanged
caveats: One post-task unpleasantness rating; men only; no neural correlate of the change

manipulation_or_design: Remifentanil vs saline during resistive-load breathlessness
direction_note: Breathlessness unpleasantness 61 to 49 (p=.03); intensity 71 to 68 (p=.21)
caveats: Breathlessness, not pain; one-tailed tests; no interaction test; changes correlated r=0.59

manipulation_or_design: Optogenetic activation or inhibition of S1->ACC terminals paired with pinprick
direction_note: Activation increased and inhibition decreased pinprick place aversion
caveats: No sensory or reflex test under manipulation; key controls in absent supplement

manipulation_or_design: No manipulation; both ratings on every trial of prolonged cold pain
direction_note: Signals tracked unpleasantness slightly more than intensity; ratings r=0.86
caveats: Graded difference by authors' account; intensity always rated first; conditions pooled

manipulation_or_design: Negative, neutral or positive picture primes before electric shock
direction_note: Unpleasantness negative > neutral > positive; only P2 change predicted it
caveats: Intensity quadratic trend p=.04, partial eta2 .12; intensity rated first; picture ERPs overlap

manipulation_or_design: Lottery reward added to a painful joystick movement (within-subject)
direction_note: Choice of the painful movement rose sharply; fear rating also unchanged
caveats: Ratings from 50%-reinforced phases, choices from 100% phase; self-selected goal groups; manuscript

manipulation_or_design: Rostral vs caudal ACC excitotoxic lesion; formalin place conditioning
direction_note: Rostral lesion abolished place avoidance; acute formalin paw behaviour not reduced
caveats: No thresholds measured; one time bin higher in lesioned rats; affect inferred from avoidance

manipulation_or_design: ACC glutamate blockade during training; agonist without noxious input; post-training lesion
direction_note: Blockade prevented avoidance learning with acute behaviour unchanged; agonist alone produced avoidance
caveats: One dose; acute behaviour not measured under agonist; authors call evidence not conclusive

manipulation_or_design: Chemogenetic silencing of an amygdala nociceptive ensemble
direction_note: Attending, escape and thermal avoidance reduced; thresholds and withdrawal unchanged
caveats: 'Unpleasantness' inferred from behaviour; methods and statistics in absent supplement

manipulation_or_design: Optogenetic activation or inhibition of ACC->dl/lPAG terminals
direction_note: Activation increased shock-zone distance and heat sensitivity together
caveats: Only activation tested in avoidance task (necessity untested); shock-zone entries unchanged

manipulation_or_design: Reaction-time pain-avoidance task: after failure vs success; migraine vs controls
direction_note: Avoidance vigour dropped after failure, more with helplessness; parietal, not PAG, tracked it
caveats: Pain rated only for calibration on one merged scale; helplessness effects n=15; manuscript

manipulation_or_design: Pain-avoidance choice learning under levodopa, naltrexone or placebo
direction_note: Both drugs raised learning from avoided pain only; placebo learned more from received pain
caveats: Intensity from a separate pre-task session; no ratings during learning; effects in model parameters

manipulation_or_design: Go/no-go learning to avoid shock or win money
direction_note: Individual avoidance learning rate tracked by dorsal and mid cingulate activity
caveats: Half of shock feedback without shock; accepted manuscript; asymmetry opposite to jepma2022

manipulation_or_design: Oral capsaicin vs chocolate vs water with continuous pleasant-unpleasant rating
direction_note: Signed valence and unsigned affective intensity decoded from largely distinct voxels
caveats: 'Intensity' is affective, not sensory; small effects; no action or avoidance measure

manipulation_or_design: Contingent vs yoked monetary reward for avoiding or discriminating heat
direction_note: Reward improved avoidance speed and success; ratings unchanged
caveats: Probe-trial ratings on mild stimuli; task-compliance confound; authors decline differential claim

manipulation_or_design: Button press vs no press crossed with painful and non-painful heat and cold
direction_note: Urge and intensity both steeper for pain (r=0.53-0.83); midcingulate followed pressing
caveats: Ratings from separate group outside scanner; no unpleasantness; press is not escape

manipulation_or_design: Grip force, painful heat, and both combined
direction_note: Adding force did not change pain rating; aMCC overlap of force and pain
caveats: One scale mixing sensation and pain; dual-task attention not excluded

manipulation_or_design: Observing and reproducing pain faces: express meaning vs imitate movements
direction_note: Cingulate pain responses in meaning task, not imitation task
caveats: Observed pain only; rating is of actors' pain, not own

manipulation_or_design: Watching painful vs non-painful clips while pressing a force sensor
direction_note: Press force rose with observer unpleasantness; pressing reduced responses to observed pain
caveats: Observed pain; desire is willingness to help, not urge to escape; press instructed (vigour)

manipulation_or_design: Natural manipulation: reduced C-fibre density (R221W carriers) vs matched controls
direction_note: Thresholds normal, urge to withdraw weaker; insula-MCC coupling tracked urge in controls
caveats: Fixed-effects group model; urge rated after scan; sensitivity difference only a trend

manipulation_or_design: Cue predicts pain; a timed press could or could not shorten it
direction_note: Responses faster when press mattered; cingulate and insula tracked predicted, not current, pain
caveats: No pain ratings; press required every trial; preregistered action tests null
